diagnosis: The GetWidgetConfig method loads dashboard widget settings using only the widget_id without scoping to the caller's workspace. While widget configurations only contain cosmetic layout positions and chart colors, an attacker can inspect dashboard layouts belonging to other workspaces.
exploit_request:
GET /dashboard/widgets/wdg_112 HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.appview.io
Authorization: Bearer workspace_token_22
Accept: application/json
